item.title: Poor Deming never stood a chance
item.description:
📝 Deming explicitly stated that management by objectives isn’t leadership, and I think you’d be hard-pressed to find managers in American companies who would agree with that sentiment. Eliminate management by objective. The idea here is that you give the organization a setpoint, and it will implement the control system that will work to achieve the setpoint.
🔗 Read more: https://surfingcomplexity.blog/2026/02/16/poor-deming-never-stood-a-chance/
